name: Receipt Intake
job: Capture private receipt evidence and reviewed purchase lines before explicitly adding received stock.
incomingHandoff: A worker has a supplier receipt and needs its reviewed quantities to become stock.
outgoingHandoff: A saved receipt draft remains reviewable, and stock changes only after the separate receive action succeeds.
responsiveBehaviour: Keep evidence, supplier facts, line quantities, totals, and posting state labelled; stack line fields on mobile instead of shrinking controls.

layoutContract.containment: A compact page header and numbered workflow guide precede the current evidence and receipt work; review, draft save, and stock posting remain visibly separate.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Posting state changes through explicit text and badges; movement is unnecessary.
